headline: 142 data-center protests across 42 states lift Reversion
body: Public pushback against AI infrastructure was the main story. Reuters counted 142 protests against AI data centers across 42 US states in July, over power bills, water use and noise. That is a broad signal of Tech Backlash, which drives Reversion, the ending where society steps back from advanced technology. In a smaller item, San Francisco ordered Apple and Google to remove 13 'nudify' apps that create non-consensual images of real people. Pushing back on such misuse slightly weakens Surveillance & Control, trimming 1984. Other endings barely moved. Horizon Balance stayed at 0.85.
movers_note: Reversion +0.5 came from the 142 data-center protests (+0.48); no other ending moved by 0.1 or more.
